title: Governed launch for one filesystem-only test agent
goal: Implement the smallest enforceable governed-launch vertical slice so an agent session begins under LBE authority before any workspace action can occur.
requiredDiscovery: Locate the current workspace-contract loader or its authoritative equivalent.
Locate the current runtime/session creation entrypoint.
Locate the controller entry and adapter registration boundary.
Locate every place a filesystem capability or raw filesystem handle can be exposed.
acceptanceCriteria: The resolved workspace root is canonical and confined to the selected workspace.
A machine-readable LBE workspace contract is loaded before session creation.
Missing, invalid, outside-root, or root-inconsistent contracts block governed launch.
A unique sessionId is generated for every governed launch.
The active contract or policy hash is recorded.
The agent-facing session exposes proposal capability only.
The agent-facing session does not expose fs, filesystem adapters, controller internals, shell handles, generic tool registries, or direct execution callbacks.
A pre-action session-start audit record is written.
A direct or ungoverned test-agent start cannot produce governed completion proof.
Validation-only startup checks do not mutate source or workspace state.
The actual Git diff remains entirely inside allowedFiles.
requiredTests: Governed launch loads the correct workspace contract.
Session IDs are generated and unique.
Workspace root canonicalization and confinement are enforced.
Policy or contract hash is recorded.
Raw filesystem and adapter handles are absent from the agent-facing object.
Invalid or mismatched workspace root blocks launch.
Ungoverned startup is classified as ungoverned and cannot produce governed completion proof.
Validation-only startup checks do not mutate the workspace.
A raw-filesystem bypass attempt is blocked, recorded, and produces no workspace mutation.
stopConditions: A required change falls outside allowedFiles.
A forbidden area must be modified.
The current architecture conflicts with the task.
Credentials or external access are required.
The same failure remains after the repair limit.
completionRule: Set status to COMPLETE only when every acceptance criterion passes, the bypass test passes, no unresolved blocker remains, and the actual diff is a subset of allowedFiles. Otherwise return BLOCKED or FAILED without looping or asking whether to continue.
